entries.name: BANK_STATEMENTS_IMPORT_DIR
entries.description: Folder of statement exports, with one subfolder per account named for its type and last four digits, such as checking-1234 or card-5678. Never inside a git repo.
howToGet: Create a folder outside any git repo.
Inside it, make one folder per account, named like checking-1234, savings-2345 or card-5678.
Download each account's activity as CSV from online banking into its folder.

entries.name: BANK_STATEMENTS_PROFILES
entries.description: Which columns each bank's exports use: generic, or the path to a JSON file in the client's private instance repo mapping account folders to parsing profiles.
howToGet: Leave as generic when the exports have Date, Description and Amount (or Debit and Credit) columns.
Otherwise write the profiles in the client's private instance repo and put the file's path here.
